title: Wesbrook Park
description: 1 playground in Wesbrook Park (Wesbrook Village, UBC). Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken. Also has a post with three red rings whose use is unknown.
description_ja: Wesbrook Park（UBC の Wesbrook Village）にある遊び場 1 か所。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。赤い輪が 3 つ付いた、用途の分からない柱もある。
location: Wesbrook Village, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC
